entities.summary: József Szakovics, Slovene Jožef Sakovič, German orthography Joseph Sakowitsch, was a Slovene Roman Catholic priest and author in the Prekmurje region. Szakovics was a defender of the linguistic rights of the Hungarian Slovenes and their Slovene identity, promoting the use of the Prekmurje Slovene of Slovene.
